content:
incbot: ALERT: multiple NCCL timeout/errors observed for tp4-inference-job-22 on cluster-gpu-east-1. Pager triggered to #incidents and @oncall-eng. Summary: repeated allreduce timeouts + CUDA driver reset events. Affected: ~12 pods across 3 nodes.

oncall-eng: On it. Pinging SRE and infra. What's the error pattern? OOM vs comm timeout?

aarya: seeing repeated 'unhandled cuda error: device-side assert' in logs plus 'NCCL WARN TIMEOUT' stacks. Also a few pods show container restart count >3.

mikko: attaching filtered logs: ```2026-03-15T14:02:10Z tp4-worker-3 stderr: NCCL WARN TIMEOUT  rank 2 ->  ...
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z tp4-worker-3 stderr: cudaErrorIllegalAddress: file=../src/alloc.c line=432
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z tp4-worker-3 kubelet: Container killed: OOMKilled
```

zara: repro rate ~60% for that job config. Node metrics show GPU mem pressure rising then a sudden drop (OOM). One node shows NIC flaps around same time (eth0 link down).

cheng: can we confirm if this is hardware (nvlink/fabric) or software (model causing OOM leading to communicator timeout)? We need to triage quickly for customer impact.

oncall-eng: Quick plan: 1) isolate one failing node, cordon+drain 2) restart NCCL env on remaining pods 3) failover traffic to dedicated fallback pool (cpu-fallback or smaller model) 4) gather core dumps/driver logs.

aarya: cordoning node gpu-node-7 now: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-7` and draining pods with `--ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`.

sre-runbot: ACTION: drain started for gpu-node-7 by aarya at 2026-03-15T14:06:30Z.

mikko: I grabbed /var/log/nvidia-installer.log and dmesg from the node. dmesg shows `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79` and `GPU reset detected`. NVLink counters show CRC errors around the same timestamps.

zara: Oof that looks like interconnect flakiness. But we also have pods with OOMKilled on other nodes. Could be spike in seq length causing KV cache growth + accidental input leading to device OOM and subsequent NCCL hang.

aarya: rolling restart of tp4 job pods in this deployment to clear any stuck NCCL communicators: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/tp4-inference`. Doing canary: restart 2 pods first.

oncall-eng: Do that. Also remove the affected node from routing so no new traffic lands there.

cheng: I'm kicking off a job to reproduce locally with smaller cluster to see if specific batch/seq combo triggers it. Sharing run id: repro-2468.

sre-runbot: NOTE: core dump collection enabled on pods with `ulimit -c unlimited` and `gdb` stacktrace collection script queued.

mikko: After restarting two pods, they join NCCL successfully and resume steps. But one pod still shows `cudaErrorLaunchFailure` followed by restart.

zara: status update for customers: we have degraded throughput for ~30 minutes for affected tenant (tenant-benchco). Some requests returned 500s (worker crash), a subset retried and succeeded. ETA on mitigation ~20-30m. Should we mark this incident as 'degraded' and notify CS?

oncall-eng: Yes, mark degraded. @cs please notify tenant-benchco with short note: "We are investigating intermittent GPU-backed model failures causing retries and degraded throughput; no data loss; mitigation in progress."

aarya: created internal ticket INF-7892 for follow-up and attached logs. Also created customer notification CN-3341.

mikko: mitigation steps working: drained gpu-node-7, drained pods rescheduled to healthy nodes, restarted problematic pods. Throughput back to ~95% of baseline. Still watching for recurrence.

cheng: one actionable: we should add a guard in the serving runtime to detect pre-NCCL device anomalies (Xid events) and fail early to avoid hanging collectives. Filing a task in infra backlog.

zara: also recommend we add a fallback routing rule in router: if deployment sees >2 restarts in 5m route to smaller model variant automatically. Low-risk change. Filing optimize ticket.

oncall-eng: For now, escalation closed for on-call; handoff to infra team for hardware investigation and platform for guard rails. @mikko @cheng you two take ownership of post-incident follow-ups.

mikko: I'll coordinate with colo ops to grab NIC and NVLink diagnostics on gpu-node-7 and run a hardware health sweep.

cheng: I'll open an RFC for a runtime preflight check and the auto-fallback policy; include test harness to simulate OOM + communicator timeouts.

aarya: quick notes for postmortem: timeline + the exact CUDA Xid codes, list of affected pods/nodes, customer impact (CN-3341), mitigation chronology, suggested fixes (runtime guard, auto-fallback, hardware swap).

sre-runbot: REMINDER: please upload collected core dumps and driver logs to S3: s3://redwood-incident-archives/INF-7892/ by EOD.

oncall-eng: Thanks team. I'll update incident channel and close pager. If anything new pops up ping @oncall-eng immediately. :thumbsup:
